name: 2017 Pack
description: This pack contains all my maps from 2017 (that I know of). There are packs for years 2017-2021 due to most of my maps during that period being lost, usually from data issues.

name: Zick Pack I
description: The first zick pack, containing the first 3 zick maps. They are all extremely easy.

name: zick Pack II
description: The second zick pack, containing the next 3 zick maps. Slightly harder than the first zick pack.

name: zick Pack III
description: Accidentally made zick 8 and zick 9 a bit too insane, so this pack will probably be the only zick pack that will never be cleared.

name: zick Pack IV
description: The last zick pack. I lost access to the in-game zick list (ID: 627) so the series ended at zick 12. These maps are extremely hard but still beatable.

name: dylan Pack
description: All maps that have 'dylan' in the title. Funnily enough, after 4 years none of these maps have actually been finished.

name: Auto Pack
description: All my maps that are auto. Some of these weren't meant to be auto, but I made it auto so that people in-game could actually see how the map looked like.
